flows.observation: Dialog append uses explicit parent-session workspace predicate because child tables lack workspace filters. Upsert turn stamps all children from parent, retries first-insert uniqueness once. Retitle/item deletion, budgeted saves and all-workspace repair mutate raw session graphs.
flows.boundary: Raw logs remain operational and logging requires no federation edit lease. Preserve complete parent/child keys, workspace isolation, additive merge, titles and retained provenance. Existing repair/del/restore must not select immutable promoted snapshots. Explicit sanitized promotion is a separate full-graph versioned operation.

flows.observation: Report/group submission and processing retarget effective workspace, persist idempotency/group/research/output state, invoke research runner, call TODO creation with retry, then save resulting CreatedTodoId and completed/failure status. Manual regroup moves report relationships with multiple saves.
flows.boundary: Triage control/research and output remain operational. Creating or compensating the authored TODO is a separate owning-project operation, not permission to bypass the edit gate because the origin is background research. Carry original target through deferral/retry/reopen and bind operational CreatedTodoId to the actual saved TODO without duplicates. Imported history cannot re-run research or create TODOs as an effect.

flows.observation: Run persistence stores sanitized draft/diagnostics, replay identity and terminal state. Reservation handles unique-race winner and operational processing lease. After TODO application, cancellation/ambiguous-save handling invokes compensation.
flows.boundary: Run state/diagnostics/processing lease remain operational; authored TODO application and compensation retain original owning gate/project/branch. Processing lease is not federation editing authority. Bind replay to actual TODO graph and preserve retry/compensation data without rerunning an incoming historical handoff.

flows.observation: Hostile review submission validates workspace/limits, saves request/artifact links/diagnostics; reviewer output records executions/findings/verdict or failure state.
flows.boundary: Review queue/executions/findings stay operational and do not auto-author project changes or promote raw evidence. Preserve original receipts, child relationships and protected paths outside cloneable history. Source limits are current behavior, not adoption of this service as the authorized cross-machine HV runner.

flows.observation: Restore loads original TODO including tombstones, replaces dependent list/task rows, restores metadata/deletion state, syncs requirement links, appends restoration audit and finalizes projection. Projection-failure metadata uses a separate fresh scope and save.
flows.boundary: Authored TODO children/links/portable metadata stay in original project operation. Audit and projection failure/time/error markers remain operational. Preserve existing write outcome despite later projection failure; do not stamp another branch, resurrect retired requirements or duplicate prior audit on retry. Native child/key/soft-delete behavior still required.

flows.observation: Startup migrator/importer create fresh scopes and conditionally read legacy SQLite/YAML only for missing marker, existing file and empty target. They save TODO child graph, historic audit and document metadata then write filesystem marker.
flows.boundary: Retain standalone behavior but do not auto-import into enrolled projects on startup. Explicit approved migration accounts for portable TODO graph versus operational historical audit/projection/markers and retains source files. File marker or nonempty target alone is not full migration verification.
